concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-risk-and-security-compliance-network-updates-2023-mastercard-f23]] - Braintree-hosted historical Mastercard update page for dated, region- and transaction-qualified preauthorization, excessive-retry, Authorization Optimizer and Merchant Advice Code changes, preserving prose/table date conflicts and an APAC code mismatch; not current network law or policy, merchant-specific pricing, account applicability, compliance proof, or fee-assessment evidence
warnings: The excessive-retry prose starts the $0.15 fee on November 1, 2023, while the adjacent table dates that rate to January 1, 2023.
The recurring-CNP Authorization Optimizer prose dates the US start to October 9, 2023, while its regional table dates the US row to October 1, 2023.
The APAC paragraph first names decline code 82 but later prints 832 in the fee combination; the source does not resolve the mismatch.
